It stretches from coastal tuskarr villages through sprawling forest tundra to looming spires of ice and snow. Regal blue dragons once roamed these lands, but with the passage of time, several tribes of tuskarr, gnolls, and furbolg now call these ancient lands their home. It is the location of the Azure Archives. Much of the zone is filled with varied biomes covered in snow and ice, giant frozen waterfalls, ice rivers, and forests shrouded in mist.

{{Neutral}} [[Winterpelt Hollow]] | affiliation = [[#Inhabitants|See below]] | loc = [[Dragon Isles]] | territory = Contested }} '''The Azure Span''' is a zone of the [[Dragon Isles]] covered in snowy peaks, mist-covered forests, and icy tundra. It stretches from coastal [[tuskarr]] villages through sprawling forest tundra to looming spires of ice and snow. Regal [[blue dragon]]s once roamed these lands, but with the passage of time, several tribes of tuskarr, [[gnoll]]s, and [[furbolg]] now call these ancient lands their home. It is the location of the [[Azure Archives]]. Much of the zone is filled with varied biomes covered in snow and ice, giant frozen waterfalls, ice rivers, and forests shrouded in mist.[https://worldofwarcraft.com/en-us/news/23823429/dragonflight-zone-preview-the-azure-span Dragonflight Zone Preview: The Azure Span] ==History== {{Stub/Lore-section|Expand on the questlines' stories and information.}} Before the [[War of the Ancients]], the region was home to the [[blue dragonflight]]. When the [[blue dragon]]s departed, the [[Brackenhide clan|Brackenhide]] [[gnoll]]s settled in the Azure Span, specifically in areas rich with ley crystals, claiming them for their own.[[Crystal Nutrition]] However, they failed to recognize the crystals' true potential.[[Ley Litter]] Following the return of the [[dragon]]s to the [[Dragon Isles]] during the [[war against the Primalists]], the [[Kirin Tor]] arrived to study the region's magical energies. As in other regions, the [[Primalists]] launched an invasion of the Azure Span, attacking [[Camp Antonidas]]. Meanwhile, the [[Dragonscale Expedition]] established outposts in the southern areas. [[Adventurer]]s from the [[Alliance]] and [[Horde]] assisted the Kirin Tor and Dragonscale Expedition in their struggles against the Primalists and local threats. They also played a crucial role in aiding the [[Iskaara tribe|Iskaara]] [[tuskarr]], who were battling the [[decay]]-corrupted Brackenhide gnolls and their minions. The Brackenhide gnolls were gradually defeated across the region. [[Brena]] called upon adventurers to venture into the heart of [[Brackenhide Hollow]] and confront [[Decatriarch Wratheye]], but Wratheye managed to escape.[[Brackenhide Hollow: To the Source]] [[Kalecgos]] returned to his ancestral home and formed a bond with the [[tuskarr]]. He collaborated with the simulacrum of [[Sindragosa]] to restore the [[Azure Oathstone]] and to reunify the blue dragonflight. Additionally, [[Sonova Snowden]] enlisted heroes to help the [[Winterpelt Furbolg|Winterpelt tribe]]. As the conflict escalated, [[Zaqali djaradin]] and their Primalist allies set up [[Suffusion Camp: Cinderwind (subzone)|Suffusion Camp: Frostburn]] at the center of the [[Upper Frostlands]]. However, they were repelled by the local inhabitants and their allies.[[Suffusion Camp: Frostburn]] Near the conclusion of the war, members of the [[Azerothian Archives]] began their excavation at the [[Traitor's Rest]] digsite. ==Geography== The Azure Span is a sprawling, mountainous zone in the southern Dragon Isles defined by its arctic climate, towering forests, frozen lakes, and ancient arcane ruins. The landscape transitions from dense woodlands and rolling, snowy hills in the south and west to rugged ice-covered cliffs and glacial plateaus in the center, north, and east.
